name: Public free releases (ship early, ship often)
summary: Standing ruling: release publicly early and as often as possible; all early releases free with no restrictions; dedicated marketing deferred until the game picks up speed. All three original release blockers (art output rights, the restrictively-licensed pack purge, CI green) cleared in late August. Publishing is a pushed version tag; the deploy runbook covers the traps.
requirements: Every public release cut from a green main via a pushed v* tag
Release notes written for players (community manager owns the words)
The deploy runbook followed — no hand-rolled deploys
Store/itch page kept current with each release
current_status: Ongoing operational project rather than a one-shot. The pipeline works (web, Android, itch); the cadence question — how often is 'as often as possible' in practice — is a standing conversation with Product.

plan.step: Release blockers cleared (rights verified, pack purged, CI green)
Deploy runbook written with known traps recorded
Establish a regular tag cadence tied to milestone closes
First post-M1.5 public build tagged and announced
